span.p:
Init 생략
checkpoint의 iteration 위치에서 남은 iterations만 전진

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 1 · oracle + accumulation
value − threshold의 MSB로 predicate 판정 · DATA_COUNT 밖과 찾은 칸은 non-solution
맞으면 two's complement negate · PE마다 32 lanes sum → 4 accumulators

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mean · 네 accumulator sum(39 bits)을 13칸 산술 우시프트
round-half-to-even → 2 × mean (25 bits)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pass 2 · diffusion operator
amp ← 2 × mean − amp · 되쓰기 직전 symmetric saturation
